note: Reviewed thumbtrack tags: a molded grip feature on the top of the disc. Freddy named the Berg, Berg X, Sled, Stasis and Range and flagged the Banger's version as different; HuckTwin's study of Nov 25, 2026 (retailer and manufacturer sources plus product photos, read in profile and angled light) verified this list. prepare_data.py copies kind onto each record as thumbtrack, and a position (groove only: shoulder, the Sled) as thumbtrackPosition for the 3D model; validate_data.py checks the set. Ruled out for now: Innova Groove (a channel across a driver's plate), Yikun Claws (grip texture), Innova Rhyno / Rhyno X (unsourced), Kastaplast Rask (a rim bump, not a thumbtrack).

kinds.raised: A raised track or pad molded into the top.
kinds.puddle: The flight plate is dished below the rim; the sunken plate is the thumb seat.
kinds.groove: A channel recessed into the top.
kinds.thumbtack: A localized raised bulge on one arc of the shoulder, a forehand grip feature, not a full ring.

discs.name: Berg
discs.note: Broad, low raised plateau following the rim across much of the flight plate; flat profile, the pad blends into the shoulder.

discs.name: Range
discs.note: In profile the rim's top edge is the highest point and the flight plate sits sunken below it, visibly concave.

discs.name: Banger-GT
discs.note: The original Groove Top: a narrow concentric channel roughly mid-plate; the profile shows the step down into it.

discs.name: Sled (DIS-0126-P)
discs.note: Same recessed channel as the Banger's, rolled into the top shoulder instead of mid-plate.
